comment: Buildings are proposed on site with overhead electric lines on adjacent property boundaries. No surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimensions are shown on building elevation sheets or plan views to verify the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained. Clearance verification exhibits are required.
applicableAreas: All buildings relative to overhead electric lines on property boundaries

comment: Transformer pad is shown on the site plan with overhead electric distribution lines on property boundaries, but no clearance dimensions from the outside conductor are provided. The required 15-foot radial clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors cannot be verified from the available plans.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad location (western side of site, near Building 1)

comment: Building elevation sheets do not include surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors. Clearance verification requires registered surveyor data showing conductor elevations and clearance dimensions to building faces and projections. This is a required element per UCM § 1.10.3.
applicableAreas: All building elevations relative to overhead electric facilities

comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings, building projections, or other site features. Clearance dimension annotations must originate from the outside conductor (not pole centerline) and extend to building edges and projections.
applicableAreas: All site plan sheets and section views

comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on any plan sheets. Where clearances are required to be dimensioned, the dimension lines must extend from the outside conductor (not from utility pole centerline or pole structure). On multi-conductor installations, the outermost conductor may be several feet offset from pole center.
applicableAreas: All site plan sheets with utility lines or clearances

comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees (marked 'M') planted within close proximity to overhead electric line on southern property boundary (approximately 4 trees in southeast corner area). The specific species of these mitigation trees are not identified on the landscape plan, making it impossible to verify whether they are utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F. Trees within 10 lateral feet of distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of transmission conductors must be from the Utility Compatible list. Provide plant schedule identifying each mitigation tree species and verify compliance with utility-compatible requirements.
applicableAreas: Trees planted near overhead electric line on southern property boundary

comment: Sheet 3 includes a pre-construction safety meeting requirement (48 hours before construction) for transmission facilities, but does not include a general contractor note requiring notification to Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. A comprehensive 48-hour notification note applicable to all overhead electric facilities (both distribution and transmission) is required on the cover sheet or general notes.

Proposed trees are positioned 0-1.5 feet from overhead electric (OHE) distribution line on southern boundary. Utility-compatibility status of specific tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) cannot be conclusively determined from submitted plans to verify whether species are marked as utility-compatible in ECM Appendix F. ECM Appendix F UC column designation not provided.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard area near Valley View Road

comment: Large trees with mature height 40+ feet (Cedar Elm and Live Oak per ECM Appendix F) are proposed at 0-1.5 feet from overhead electric distribution conductor. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 25 lateral feet clearance. Measured distances: 0 feet (westernmost), 1.5 feet (central), 0 feet (easternmost).
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard area near Valley View Road

comment: Proposed tree measured at 8.5 lateral feet from overhead electric utility pole. UCM § 1.10.10.4 prohibits trees within 10 lateral feet of poles. Tree location is 1.5 feet closer than minimum required distance.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near utility poles

comment: Proposed tree measured at 1.7 lateral feet from pad-mounted electrical transformer equipment. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from pad-mounted equipment or between equipment access door and drivable surface. Tree position violates distance requirement by 8.3 feet.
applicableAreas: Central parking area - landscape island adjacent to electrical transformer pad

comment: Trees are shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities (OHE line depicted on Sheet 31; transformer pad locations identifiable). However, NO dimension lines, clearance distances, or measurement references are provided on the landscape plan. Clearances cannot be verified from the plan drawings; applicant must add dimension lines and clearance notations from tree trunk centers to outside conductors (for overhead lines) and equipment locations.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - entire OHE line; central parking area - transformer pad locations

comment: Plans propose trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) within prohibited clearance zones: trees within 15-25 feet of overhead distribution conductors and within 10 feet of utility poles and transformer equipment. No documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing these variations is provided or referenced on the plans, in the site plan notes, or in the submitted documents.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard trees near OHE line; central parking area - tree near transformer pad

comment: Transformer Pad 2 (mid-western side yard near Building 2) is located only 0.9 feet from the nearest water line; Transformer Pad 3 (southwest area near Building 8) has zero clearance/overlaps with the water line. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance required. Relocate pads or reroute water lines to achieve required clearance.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 2 mid-western location near Building 2
Transformer Pad 3 southwest location near Building 8

comment: Transformer Pad 1 (northwest entrance area near Building 1) is located 4.6 feet from the nearest wastewater line; Transformer Pad 2 (mid-western side yard near Building 2) is 2.5 feet from wastewater line. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance required from all sides. Relocate pads or reroute wastewater lines to achieve required clearance.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 northwest location near Building 1
Transformer Pad 2 mid-western location near Building 2

comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not shown on the submitted electrical plan. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets (which specify pad dimensions based on service type and equipment specifications) are included in the site plan submission. Provide AE Design approval letter and transformer pad detail sheets confirming pad dimensions match the specifications for the proposed service type (single-phase or three-phase).
